fields: Hipparcos number in the low 24 bits; flags above

flags.0x80000000: distance is a lower bound from a poor parallax (capped at 5000 pc)
flags.0x40000000: B-V missing in XHIP: estimated from V-I, or 0.65

axes: equatorial J2000 (ICRS): +x to RA 0h Dec 0, +y to RA 6h Dec 0, +z to the north celestial pole; origin the Sun
epoch: positions carried from J1991.25 to J2000 by proper motion
distance: XHIP Dist, else 1000/Plx (Plx >= 2 e_Plx), else 1000/max(Plx, 2 e_Plx, 0.2 mas) capped 5000 pc; the 19 stars with no Hipparcos parallax (added from I/239) get the median distance of well-measured stars of their V, flagged
credit: XHIP: Anderson & Francis 2012, Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (VizieR V/137D), from the Hipparcos new reduction (van Leeuwen 2007, ESA). VizieR catalogue service, CDS, Strasbourg.
terms: VizieR/CDS: free to use with acknowledgement of the catalogue and of CDS
